notif.note: endedTitledCount=2 is NOT a duplication bug: only 1 'Ca làm đã kết thúc' is seeded; the 2 generated ones are for different shifts with distinct dedupeKeys. dedupeDuplicates is empty.

timestampRendering.note: vi-VN Intl.DateTimeFormat renders TIME FIRST then date: 'HH:mm:ss DD/MM/YYYY'. The notification timestamp IS rendered on both the bell panel and the dashboard cards. A separate probe (now removed) confirmed rendered font-mono texts e.g. '12:07:33 30/05/2026' inside [role=dialog] .font-mono and on dashboard .font-mono. The earlier bellHasTimestamp:false was a probe-regex artifact (it expected date-first DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm:ss) plus a strict-mode multi-match on [role=dialog], NOT a product bug.
